comment: Seller fee schedules per platform and seller region, verified 2026-09-09 against etsy.com/legal/fees (via voolist.com and craftybase.com breakdowns) and ebay.com/help/selling/fees-credits-invoices/selling-fees. Percentages apply to the gross the buyer pays (item plus shipping); the scripts apply them to the item price only, since shipping is charged to the buyer at cost. extra_pct is for Offsite Ads (Etsy: 15%, 12% above 10k USD a year, mandatory there) or a regulatory operating fee; 0 because neither is certain per sale. Copy to $DAPILOT_STORE_DIR/reference/platform-fees.json and edit; the plugin copy is the fallback.

EU.payment_fixed_note: 0.30 EUR, at about 1.10 USD per EUR

ebay.listing_fee_note: first 250 listings a month free, then 0.35 USD
ebay.transaction_note: final value fee, most categories, includes payment processing, on item plus shipping plus sales tax up to 7,500 USD

US.payment_fixed_note: per-order fee: 0.30 up to 10 USD orders, 0.40 above

EU.payment_pct_note: international fee 1.65% when not using eBay International Shipping

shipping.comment: Buyer pays shipping at cost unless seller_pays is true. packaging_g is added to model_g for the parcel. table_usd is optional [{max_g, usd}] brackets; empty means viability.json reports shipping as unknown. dapi's shipping rates by zone are the right source once an ORDER-scoped key exists.
